Nonshellability follows from torsion of pure 8-dimensional complex.

value.rationale: Chvátal is the canonical smallest 4-regular triangle-free 4-chromatic graph, and its three-cut complex lies outside existing torsion-free families because 4-cycles overlap. A complete explicit Moore M(Z/2,7) homotopy determination gives a natural integral torsion/non-shellability boundary case; the signed degree-two attachment has genuine structure not implied by face count or rational homology.

limitations: Exactly one finite labelled 12-vertex graph and ordinary three-cut, not a graph-family formula.
